facts.fact: The TAG 2018 fraud benchmark study measured general invalid traffic (GIVT) and sophisticated invalid traffic (SIVT) over 75 billion impressions of display and video inventory on Desktop, Mobile and In App devices.
facts.quote: The [2018 Study](https://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/2848641/Tag2018fraudbenchmarkstudy.pdf) measured general invalid traffic (GIVT) and sophisticated invalid traffic (SIVT) over 75 billion impressions

facts.fact: According to the TAG fraud benchmark study as cited by StackAdapt, the industry average for overall fraud rate is 10.43%.
facts.quote: The industry average for overall fraud rate is 10.43%, while the average for TAG Certified Channels is 1.68%.

facts.fact: StackAdapt claims its traffic is 91% cleaner than the industry average (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: StackAdapt’s traffic is 91% cleaner than the industry average and 41% cleaner than other TAG Certified Channels

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that it surpassed both the industry and TAG Certified Channels fraud benchmarks with a lower overall fraud rate for the second consecutive year.
facts.quote: StackAdapt surpassed both benchmarks with a lower overall fraud rate, for the second consecutive year.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt fraud-prevention blog post was published on December 19, 2018.
